userStories.title: Wire inwise-desktop-shared submodule into inwise-opensource
userStories.description: Add the inwise-desktop-shared repo as a git submodule at src/shared/, update tsconfig paths so imports from the shared module resolve, change all callers of audio-utils and mfcc in OSS main process to import from the shared submodule, delete the now-redundant local copies, verify the OSS build is green. The shared repo's main branch already has these utils mirrored verbatim â€” runtime behavior must be identical.
acceptanceCriteria: Run `git submodule add https://github.com/Wise-Ai-Org/inwise-desktop-shared.git src/shared` from repo root. Verify `.gitmodules` file is created with the [submodule "src/shared"] block pointing at the shared repo URL with path = src/shared

After submodule add, verify src/shared/ contains the populated shared repo working tree (e.g., src/shared/src/utils/audio-utils.ts and src/shared/src/utils/mfcc.ts exist; src/shared/package.json exists)
Run `cd src/shared && npm install && npm run build && cd ../..` so the submodule has its dist/ built (needed for the import paths to resolve at runtime)

Update OSS root tsconfig files: tsconfig.main.json should declare a `paths` mapping like `"@inwise/desktop-shared": ["src/shared/dist/index"]` (or equivalent relative path that resolves to the shared module's built output). Verify by running typecheck below.

Find all files in inwise-opensource/src/ that import from './audio-utils' or './mfcc' or '../audio-utils' or '../mfcc' (use grep). Update each import to `import { ... } from '@inwise/desktop-shared'` (or whatever path alias was chosen above)
Delete src/main/audio-utils.ts and src/main/mfcc.ts from inwise-opensource
Run typecheck â€” `npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit` passes (existing OSS typecheck command from package.json; verify which command is used by reading package.json scripts)
Run `npm run build` (or the equivalent OSS build script per package.json) and verify it succeeds end-to-end
Verify by grep that NO file under inwise-opensource/src/ still imports from a path ending in './audio-utils' or './mfcc' (other than the shared submodule itself)
Commit ALL changes (.gitmodules, modified tsconfig, modified callers, deleted originals) with message `feat: US-005 â€” wire inwise-desktop-shared submodule, retire local audio-utils + mfcc`
